repos_data.description: Describe it or draw it — Kiln makes it real. The open-source MCP server for 3D printing: AI agents (Claude, Codex, Cursor, or any MCP client) design, generate, slice & print on Bambu Lab, Creality, Prusa, Elegoo, Klipper/Moonraker, OctoPrint, Duet/RepRapFirmware & any Marlin printer.
